papers.authors: Vage Taamazyan, Zhuowen Shen, Stefan Hinterstoisser, Alberto Dall'Olio, Agastya Kalra, Aarrushi Shandilya, Xin Li, Wenping Wang, Kartik Venkataraman
papers.evidence: 使用无归纳偏置的Transformer做立体匹配，证明纯数据驱动可胜出显式几何约束，与双目深度估计主题高度相关。
papers.tldr: 立体匹配任务传统上严重依赖架构归纳偏置，认为这是高精度和效率的前提。本文提出NBS方法，采用完全无偏置的端到端Vision Transformer，仅依靠大规模合成数据训练，实现了最优精度并显著提升运行效率。结果表明显式几何偏置不再是必需，为3D重建的持续改进打开了新的缩放定律空间。
papers.abstract_en: Stereo reconstruction is one of the last remaining Computer Vision tasks where all state-of-the-art methods employ a heavy architectural inductive bias. Even though it has been demonstrated that the task can be solved using general-purpose methods, it is widely believed that inductive biases in stereo are strictly necessary for both high-quality results and computational efficiency. We challenge this paradigm. In this paper, we demonstrate that both state-of-the-art accuracy and superior runtime efficiency are achievable with a model completely devoid of architectural inductive biases, relying instead on a simple, end-to-end Vision Transformer. By training on massive synthetic datasets, we show that pure data-driven learning can surpass explicitly engineered geometry. This work proves that explicit inductive biases are no longer a prerequisite for stereo matching, ultimately unlocking true scaling laws for continuous improvement in 3D reconstruction.

papers.title_en: FoRIS: Progressive Foreground Refinement for Training-Free In-Context Segmentation
papers.authors: Ming Hu, Jianfu Yin, Mingyu Dou, Miaomiao Zhang, Yao Wang, Cong Hu, Bingliang Hu, Quan Wang
papers.evidence: 无训练上下文分割可处理任意视觉类别的前景细化
papers.tldr: 针对上下文分割中直接匹配参考-查询导致预测粗糙的问题，论文从经典分割视角出发，将任务视为由粗到细的前景渐进精化过程，并提出免训练的FoRIS框架。该方法通过前景净化、定位与整合三阶段逐步抑制背景干扰、定位判别区域并恢复完整结构，在1-shot和5-shot设置下分别较现有方法平均提升4.5和4.8 mIoU，实现语义与部件分割的SOTA性能。
papers.abstract_en: In-Context Segmentation (ICS) aims to precisely segment arbitrary semantic concepts, such as objects or parts, given one or a few annotated visual exemplars. In this paper, we revisit ICS from a more classical segmentation perspective, viewing it as a coarse-to-fine progressive refinement process. Rather than directly predicting the final mask through reference-query matching, we progressively refine the segmentation from coarse and ambiguous foreground responses to precise and complete foreground structures. Building upon this perspective, we propose a training-free in-context segmentation framework, termed FoRIS. Specifically, FoRIS consists of three key stages: Foreground Purification, Foreground Localization, and Foreground Consolidation, which progressively suppress background distractions, localize discriminative target regions, and recover complete foreground structures through semantic aggregation. Experimental results demonstrate that FoRIS achieves SOTA performance across semantic and part segmentation tasks, with average improvements of 4.5 and 4.8 mIoU points over existing approaches in the 1-shot and 5-shot settings, respectively. Code: https://github.com/Xi-Mu-Yu/FoRIS.

papers.title_en: Zero-Shot Novel Depth Synthesis Using 3D Foundation Models Scene Representations
papers.authors: Denis M. Akola, David F. Fouhey
papers.evidence: 利用3D基础模型内部场景表征进行零样本深度估计
papers.tldr: 近年来，三维基础模型借助前馈变换器可预测统一的场景表征，并在多种三维视觉任务上表现优异。本文假设其内部表示包含丰富的三维几何先验，足以支持从未见视角推断场景深度。作者首先验证了能从该表示中解码隐藏表面，继而提出Z3D，在基础模型表征上进行潜在扩散，直接合成新视角点图。在多个公开数据集上，Z3D无需微调即可获得连贯逼真的深度图，实现跨数据集的新视角预测。这表明大规模三维预训练表示可作为通用先验，为零样本新视角深度合成提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Foundation Models (3DFMs) such as VGGT have recently pushed the boundaries of 3D vision by predicting rich unified representations with feed-foward transformers. The scene representations learned by these models enable strong performance on multiple 3D vision tasks. In this paper, we investigate using their internal representations to infer 3D in the scene from new views. Our hypothesis is that in order to solve the task of 3D reconstruction, these models need to learn a representation that includes a large amount of general knowledge about 3D scenes. After showing that it is possible to decode hidden surfaces from internal 3DFM representations, we propose a method, Z3D, that estimates pointmaps in unseen views by doing latent diffusion on 3DFM representation. We show that Z3D can predict realistic depth maps for new views across multiple datasets.

papers.title_en: PhasorNet: Learning Structure from Frequency for Real-Time Stereo Matching
papers.authors: Md Raqib Khan, Santosh Kumar Vipparthi, Subrahmanyam Murala
papers.evidence: 以频域相位增强结构学习，实现实时立体匹配并应对细结构/反光/透明等病态区域
papers.tldr: 立体匹配在细结构、反光或透明等病态区域常因外观线索模糊而变得不可靠，精度提升受限。为此提出 PhasorNet 轻量框架，从频域中学习结构：核心 Phase-Augmented Transformer 将傅里叶相位信息注入注意力机制，增强特征的几何判别能力与光照鲁棒性；Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module 则融合全分辨率卷积与轻量注意力分支，保住细节与边界。训练时采用多尺度边缘引导高误差区域损失，自适应强化困难区域优化。模型仅 5.3M 参数，在 ETH3D 上取得领先精度，并展现 KITTI 跨域泛化能力，为实时立体匹配提供高效实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate stereo matching remains challenging in ill-posed regions such as fine structures, reflective, or transparent objects, where appearance cues are often ambiguous or unreliable. To tackle this, we propose PhasorNet, a lightweight yet powerful framework that boosts geometric discrimination via frequency-domain cues. At its core, the Phase-Augmented Transformer (PAT) injects Fourier-derived phase information into the attention mechanism, yielding photometrically robust, structure-preserving features that prioritize structural consistency in difficult areas. Additionally, we develop a Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module (GCFRM) that combines a full-resolution convolutional stream with a lightweight attention-based stream (leveraging WQA and CDGA blocks) to efficiently preserve fine details and object boundaries without excessive overhead. Training is further enhanced by a multi-scale Edge-guided High-Error Region (EHR) loss that adaptively focuses optimization on high-error and edge regions, guiding hierarchical cost volume refinement. With only 5.3M parameters, PhasorNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging ETH3D benchmark while exhibiting excellent cross-domain generalization on KITTI, delivering an efficient and practical solution for accurate real-time stereo matching.

papers.title_en: Efficient Semantic Understanding from Digital Foveation
papers.authors: Caterina Caccavella, Vittorio Fra, Andreas Ziegler, Giulia D'Angelo, Yulia Sandamirskaya
papers.evidence: 通过数字中央凹感知实现高效密集语义分割
papers.tldr: 语义分割通常对所有像素均匀分配计算，缺乏对场景复杂度和任务相关性的适应。受生物视觉启发，本文提出一种轻量级主动视觉管线，结合显著性驱动的注视点选择、高分辨率中央凹观察、低分辨率上下文、语义累积与自适应计算，在稀疏观察下实现高效语义理解。在ADE20K-Object上，单次注视达到基线95.9%的Top-1和96.9%的Top-3准确率，仅用4.7%的计算量；场景级语义累积恢复90.6%的物体召回率，计算量为58.6%。结果表明选择性计算分配可使稀疏观察产生显著语义理解，推动超越像素级分割的评估协议。
papers.abstract_en: Dense semantic segmentation allocates computational resources uniformly across the entire image, regardless of scene complexity or task relevance. Inspired by biological vision, we investigate whether semantic understanding can be achieved more efficiently through digital foveated perception. We introduce a lightweight active-vision pipeline that combines saliency-driven fixation selection, high-resolution foveal observations, low-resolution contextual information, semantic accumulation, and adaptive computation. Beyond conventional dense prediction metrics, we use object-level evaluation to measure semantic understanding under sparse observations. On ADE20K-Object, a single foveated observation achieves 95.9% of the baseline Top-1 accuracy and 96.9% of the baseline Top-3 accuracy while requiring only 4.7% of the computational cost. At the scene level, semantic accumulation recovers 90.6% of the baseline object recall while using 58.6% of the computation. These results suggest that substantial semantic understanding can emerge from sparse observations when computation is allocated selectively, highlighting active vision as an efficient alternative to uniform dense processing and motivating evaluation protocols beyond conventional pixel-wise segmentation metrics.

papers.title_en: When Depth Hurts: Reliability-Aware Geometry Distillation for Depth-Free RGB-D Salient Object Detection
papers.authors: Xuehao Wang, Jiaxin Hua, Runmei Li, Zhenyu Wu, Chenglizhao Chen, Ke Gu, Aimin Hao
papers.evidence: 使用冻结的Depth Anything V2教师模型蒸馏稠密相对几何，体现深度基础模型的应用。
papers.tldr: RGB-D显著目标检测中，深度噪声和结构缺陷会经多模态融合放大，甚至使检测差于纯RGB，现有质量方法仍依赖可能缺陷的深度。提出可靠性感知几何蒸馏：以冻结的Depth Anything V2为训练教师，将相对几何与边界结构蒸馏进紧凑几何分支，并用像素级可靠性估计选择与RGB一致的几何，推理时完全去掉深度。该方法在三十六项对比中二十六项最佳或并列最佳，ReDWeb-S上平均绝对误差降低13.4%，PASCAL-S上F值提升4.2%，展示了免深度训练的有效性与跨域可迁移性。
papers.abstract_en: Depth can resolve appearance ambiguity in RGB-D salient object detection (SOD), yet sensor depth is not uniformly reliable. Missing regions, blurred boundaries, and structural artifacts can propagate through multimodal fusion and make an RGB-D detector less accurate than its RGB-only counterpart. Existing quality-aware approaches regulate observed depth but remain dependent on the same potentially defective modality. We propose \method, a reliability-aware geometry distillation framework developed for RGB-D SOD benchmarks without using dataset-provided depth during training or inference. A frozen Depth Anything V2 model serves only as a training-time teacher, transferring dense relative geometry, hierarchical spatial attention, and boundary structure to a compact edge-aware geometry branch. Pooled bidirectional interaction aligns geometry with appearance, and a pixel-wise reliability estimator selectively injects geometry that is compatible with the current RGB representation. The teacher is removed after training, leaving an RGB-only inference network. Trained on 2,985 RGB-mask pairs, \method{} achieves the best or tied-best result in 26 of 36 metric-dataset comparisons against ten recent RGB-D SOD methods, including a 13.4\% relative MAE reduction on ReDWeb-S. When retrained on DUTS-TR, it also improves the strongest prior $F$-measure by 4.2\% on PASCAL-S, showing that the distilled geometry transfers beyond a particular sensor or dataset domain. Code will be released upon publication.
